description:
Schema for a beamline values.yaml (epik8s-btf, epik8-sparc, epik8s-euaps and friends). Reference it from the top of the file with:
  # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infn-epics/ibek-templates/refs/heads/main/schemas/beamline.schema.json
It reuses ioc.schema.json for the IOC entries, so devgroup/devfunc/ps/motor/zones/limits get the same completion and validation there as in a single-IOC file. Deliberately permissive on the deployment-side blocks (services, applications, cronjobs, dashboard, backend, opi, nfs*, syncPolicy): those are Helm chart inputs whose shape is owned by the charts, not by this schema, so they are typed only loosely to avoid false errors.

beamline.description: Short beamline identifier (btf, sparc, euaps). Used as a name prefix throughout the chart.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the beamline is deployed into.

ingressClassName.description: Ingress class used by the beamline services (e.g. nginx).

targetRevision.description: Default chart revision for the deployed services.

gitrev.description: Branch/revision of giturl to deploy from.

email.description: SMTP settings used by the alarm/notification services.

baseIp.description: CIDR from which per-service cluster IPs are allocated (e.g. 10.43.244.0/22).

startIp.description: Offset within baseIp at which allocation starts.

iocDefaults.description: Per-template defaults merged into each IOC that names the template. The key is the value of an IOC's 'template' field; the value is a partial IOC, so iocname/iocprefix are not required here. IOC-specific values always override these.

epicsConfiguration.description: EPICS-side configuration: channel access settings, the deployed services, and the IOC list.

name.description: Name of the ConfigMap carrying the CA/PVA environment.

address_list.description: EPICS_CA_ADDR_LIST for the gateways. Empty or null means auto.

services.description: Deployed EPICS services (archiver, gateway, pvagateway, olog, dashboard, ...). Shape is owned by the individual service charts, so it is not constrained here.

iocs.description: The IOCs of this beamline, as a map keyed by IOC name. Each entry is an IOC as described by ioc.schema.json, with 'name' (not 'iocname') repeating the key: the chart iterates the values only, so 'name' must be present in the entry. A map lets Helm merge several values files per IOC (e.g. values-linac.yaml + values-accumulator.yaml). The legacy list form (entries with 'name') is still accepted by the chart but is deprecated.

anyOf.description: Deprecated: list of IOCs. Convert to a map keyed by IOC name.

applications.description: Extra ArgoCD applications deployed alongside the beamline.

cronjobs.description: Scheduled jobs deployed alongside the beamline.

dashboard.description: Dashboard deployment inputs (owned by the dashboard chart).

backend.description: Backend deployment inputs (owned by the backend chart).

opi.description: OPI repository/checkout configuration for the console and dbwr.

nfsMounts.description: NFS mounts made available to services/IOCs.

syncPolicy.description: ArgoCD sync policy applied to the generated applications.

beamlineIoc.description: One IOC entry of epicsConfiguration.iocs: the IOC fields of ioc.schema.json, identified by 'name' rather than 'iocname'.
